intent: For each of the three investigating prompts of Module 0, show the question asked, the Google Cloud product agy checked to answer it, and what it found: six agents, three of them ours; one agent runs without being listed; and, from the audit logs plus re-reading each workload's login setting, two agents share one login.

mandatory: Exactly three horizontal lanes, each with exactly three cards joined left to right by two arrows
The three product cards are soft blue; the lane 1 finding card is light grey; the lane 2 finding card is soft red; the lane 3 finding card is soft amber
'promo-agent-shadow' and 'novasmart-customer-sa' are each in a monospace face on ONE line inside a wide pill; each pill is wide enough that the identifier is never wrapped or hyphenated
Every card label is semibold near-black ink (#1F2328), never grey; a sans-serif label may wrap onto two lines only at a space; the two monospace identifiers never wrap
The title is bold, large, top-left and on one line
The cards fill their lanes: each card is at least 15% of the frame height tall, so there is no large empty area
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide
'Audit logs + agent settings' is one string in one weight inside the lane 3 product card; it may wrap onto two lines only after the '+' ('Audit logs +' / 'agent settings')
prohibitions: NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines' anywhere
NO project IDs, NO email addresses, NO 'projects/' paths, NO '@' characters
NO people, faces, hands or characters
NO step numbers, lane numbers or column headings
NO green anywhere in the image
NO check marks, ticks or crosses
NO fourth lane and NO fourth card in any lane
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO identifier broken across two lines (never 'promo-agent-' on one line and 'shadow' on the next, never 'novasmart-' on one line and 'customer-sa' on the next)
NO alteration of 'novasmart-customer-sa' or 'promo-agent-shadow' such as underscores, spaces or capital letters
alt_text: The title reads: What each prompt tested. Three rows, each read left to right with arrows: question, product, finding. What do we have? leads to Agent Registry, which found 6 agents, 3 are ours. What is running? leads to Agent Runtime + Cloud Run, which found Running, not listed, with promo-agent-shadow in a red box. Who read customer data? leads to Audit logs + agent settings, which found One login, two agents, with novasmart-customer-sa in an amber box.
